# Roami - Your Global Connectivity Expert

> Roami is a professional global eSIM service provider dedicated to being your connectivity expert. Covering 200+ countries and regions and trusted by over 1M+ global users, Roami offers instant activation, local network auto-connect, and seamless travel without physical SIMs or hidden roaming fees. Auto price match guarantees the best rates.

- **New User Discount:** Get 20% OFF your first order with promo code: `web20`.
- **Free eSIM Trial:** Your first eSIM is free! Download the App to get 100MB free data (No credit card required). Suitable for sending/receiving 50 emails, 1 day of text messaging, or 5 hours of web browsing.

##  How to Use (3 Simple Steps)
1. **Check Device Compatibility:** Dial `*#06#` → If an EID number appears, your device supports eSIM.
2. **Purchase & Install:** Enter your destination, buy an eSIM plan, and follow the prompts to install.
3. **One-Click Activation:** Activate with one click upon arrival to connect to the local high-speed network.

## Why Choose Roami (Key Features)
- **Diverse Plans, Flexible Choices:** Daily unlimited plans, 1GB-30GB data plans, various durations, and voice call options.
- **Stable & Secure Network:** Partnered with top operators in 200+ countries for premium coverage.
- **High Cost-Performance:** Highly competitive pricing; money saved can buy you an extra cup of premium coffee.
- **Worry-Free Refund Policy:** Full refund if the plan doesn't work or remains unused.
- **24/7 Human Support:** 365 days of online assistance with rapid response times.
- **Localized Support:** Supports 21 languages, multiple currencies, and local payment methods.
